chunks: Has he turned the gods into one deity? Indeed, this is a strange thing!
ai.seo_question: Why did the polytheists find monotheism strange according to Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In Surah Sad, Allah quotes the polytheists' incredulity at the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) consolidating numerous idols into one God, describing the message as 'a strange thing' (shay'un 'ujab). This verse underscores the core Shia theological emphasis on Tawhid, highlighting how the rejection of divine unity often stems from an inability to comprehend the simplicity of monotheism amidst complex polytheistic traditions.
